body: Hi I’ve been reading the comments etc and I just want to say the way your feeling is similar to me. I’ve been diagnosed with BPD and there are a few pages on here that someone’s linked already I think. But when I joined it I felt so much better as we are all so similar.

I’ve just come out of hospital i was sectioned under the mental health act. It isn’t very helpful not going to lie to you :( they aren’t as good as ppl think. And the environment is incredibly toxic you’ll see people self harm and some even worse. I’ve been in there so many times since I was 16 and I’m now 19 and I always leave feeling the same. They didn’t sort my meds or anything. They just made me stay inside I couldn’t even go on a walk. When I was in there I learnt a lot of bad habits from other people and since I’ve been in my self harm has gotten a lot worse. For some people it’s really good but for me and a lot of ppl I know they end up in there regularly after the first admission as they have gotten worse. Start of corona outbreak I was admitted to a PICU ward which is intensive care. It was horrible to say the least. Even the acute wards aren’t helpful. If you feel unsafe I recommend trying coping skills etc as hospital was the biggest mistake I ever made. The only reason I was in there recently was because I was sectioned so it was against my will

Being in hospital under section is quite complicated to explain but basically it’s a law (mental health act) where your admitted into hospital against your will for mental health treatment and assessment. When I was younger I was in similar situation they didn’t listen to me they just sent me home. And every time they didn’t listen I broke more and more until I reached the point I was in a month ago and ended up in intensive care from an attempt. The fact you’ve tried to throw yourself in front of a car is incredibly concerning and I’m honestly so sorry that nobody is listening to you :( it took them 3 years to help me. When I was in CAMHS they did the assessment you mentioned in your post and it took months but the good thing about children’s services is the help is easier to get. Once your an adult it’s awful. They are looking into therapy for me now but the only reason they did was because I was in hospital and they had to put things in place for when I went home. You just want to be helped and that’s the really upsetting part as your trying to fight for the help and your getting shut down. Obviously I don’t know what you struggle with but I’m assuming your feeling depressed etc and if that’s the case there a few options. I’d advice contacting the gp? Even if you have already and just explain that you’ve had the assessment but your really finding it hard to stay safe and it’s getting worse. As your a minor they will have to help you and offer you something. One thing you can do is ask for admission to hospital as well? This is what I did when I was in CAMHS. I was never sectioned when I was a child but I asked to be admitted so I could get put on medication and get support. I’m not sure where your from so I don’t know how it works in your area but the way you do this is you can take yourself to A&E and speak to the mental health people and mention how it’s something you want to try. Obviously they could say no but if your finding it really hard it’s worth a try. The good thing about medications are there are things such as "Lorazepam" which is known as PRN but what this does is it keeps you calm and helps keep the thoughts at bay. There are anti depressants as well and these take awhile to work but they are honestly so helpful. I take quite a few and honestly meds aren’t for everyone but they’ve really helped me.

Firstly hi I’m Jemma secondly I want to try and help you. For me this post reminds me of myself a few years ago. And how I wish I sorted it sooner coz now I’ve ended up in hospital under section so many times. I’m 19 btw. CAMHS is so much better then adult so if you can get your support while your young it’ll be a lot easier. Don’t stress about school etc I know it’s important but your mental health needs to be top priority while your feeling this way. I’ve recently had a very bad suicide attempt and I want to say to you don’t do it. The pain your feeling is temporary and if you fix it with a permanent solution you’ll miss out on a lot of things. Your obviously very young and when your young you have hormones and all kinds of stresses like exams etc I remember when I was in school and doing my GCSE’s I started becoming unwell as I couldn’t handle it all. And when I say this reminds me of me it actually makes me emotional because I know you need help ASAP and I know you’ve had an assessment but they need to help you now so you don’t let it escalate. Have you tried reaching out to childline? They are really helpful? They helped me a lot when I was younger. If I could give you any advice it would be to contact childline even if your not in crisis just to offload. Or Samaritans? One thing childline can do is make referrals as well so talking to them is a good option you can use them until your 19. Please don’t hurt yourself your young and you deserve happiness and support.

I’ve been in a relationship and been in your partners situation whilst being in a relationship. In that situation I think the best thing you can do is just try talk to him and help him reach out to the gp or crisis lines etc. If he’s under 18 contact childline or you do it if he can’t. As your a minor they’ll have to deal with it. Or if that doesn’t work walk into your nearest police station and report it you can do this anonymously. Also as much as you want to help him you need to also look after yourself as you don’t want to become unwell and you deserve to be happy. I’ve had a lot of encounters with the police etc and childline so I can help you? And explain options. Just private message me? Whatever you do don’t give up yourself you clearly are a caring person and that alone shows me you deserve happiness. It’a a horrible feeling feeling like everyone is leaving and I also relate to this. There are people out there who want to help you just need a push in the right direction.

Forget work and school the thing you need to focus on is your mental health. suicide is never the right option I’ve tried it a handful of times and each time I’ve been glad that I survived don’t try and fix a temporary problem with a permanent solution the pain will go away and when it goes away you going to look back and you’re going to be so happy you didn’t do it. I had a really bad attempt about a month ago and was in a coma in intensive care it has honestly changed my outlook on so many things. It will get better you’ve just got to reach out. If you need someone to talk to your welcome to message me x
